metadata.description: Custom ESLint rules for developing Theia extensions and applications
Theia re-export helper functions and scripts.
Theia - Example code to demonstrate Theia API Provider Extensions
Theia - AI Tool Sketchpad for defining ad-hoc LLM tools

metadata.scriptContent: lerna run prepare --scope="@theia/re-exports" && lerna run generate-theia-re-exports --scope="@theia/core"
concurrently --kill-others -n tsc,bundle,run -c red,yellow,green "tsc -b -w --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run -s watch:bundle" "npm run -s start"

metadata.description: Theia - Example code to demonstrate Theia API

metadata.scriptContent: cd ../browser && rimraf .tmp.cfg && cross-env THEIA_CONFIG_DIR=$PWD/.tmp.cfg npm run start
npm run build && cross-env USE_ELECTRON=true playwright test --config=./configs/playwright.config.ts
npm run ui-tests-report-generate && allure open allure-results/allure-report
theia-re-exports generate && theia-re-exports template README_TEMPLATE.md > README.md
npm run rebuild && theia build --mode development
concurrently --kill-others -n tsc,bundle,run -c red,yellow,green "tsc -b -w --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run -s watch:bundle" "npm run -s start"
npm run rebuild && theia build --mode development
npm run rebuild && theia build --mode production
npm run -s test -- --test-coverage && npm run -s coverage:report
concurrently --kill-others -n tsc,bundle,run -c red,yellow,green "tsc -b -w --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run -s watch:bundle" "npm run -s start"
